title: Roblox Obby & Web Launcher
description: The ultimate unblocked Roblox experience: run through the challenging 3D Stud Obby obstacle course or launch web cloud gaming sessions.
instructions: In Blox Obby: use A/D or Arrow keys to steer and Space/Up to jump across studded blocks and avoid red lava hazards. Or switch to Cloud Launcher to play web Roblox!

title: Neon Snake
description: Guide the glowing serpent, collect energy apples, and grow as long as possible without hitting walls or your own tail.
instructions: Use Arrow keys or WASD to navigate. Eat the glowing orbs to gain length and points. Watch out for speed boosts as you score higher!

title: 2048 Legend
description: Slide matching numbered tiles across the 4x4 grid. When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one!
instructions: Slide in 4 directions to merge duplicate tiles. Plan ahead to build up to 1024, 2048, and beyond without filling the board.

title: Tetro Blocks
description: The quintessential block-stacking puzzle. Rotate and position geometric tetrominoes to clear full horizontal lines.
instructions: Stack blocks cleanly. Clearing multiple lines at once earns massive bonus points. As level increases, blocks fall faster.

title: Space Defenders
description: Defend the planet against waves of descending alien warships. Utilize planetary barricades and eliminate motherships.
instructions: Move your cannon ship along the bottom defense line. Blast approaching alien ranks before they penetrate the surface perimeter.

title: Retro Flap
description: Tap to flap wings and navigate through dangerous vertical pipe obstacles. Timing is everything!
instructions: Each tap gives upward impulse against gravity. Squeeze through pipe gaps without colliding to collect medal tiers.

title: Neon Breakout
description: Smash your way through multi-layered brick formations using precise paddle angles, speed, and combo multipliers.
instructions: Keep the energetic ball in play. Angle your paddle hits to reach hidden top layers and clear every brick on screen.

title: Cyber Pong
description: The grandfather of video games reimagined with responsive paddle physics, 3 difficulty bots, and local 2-Player mode.
instructions: Deflect the high-speed cyber orb past your opponent's defense line. First player to score 7 points wins the match.

title: T-Rex Horizon
description: Sprint endlessly across the prehistoric desert, vaulting over sharp cacti and ducking under swooping pterodactyls.
instructions: Jump over desert hazards and duck under airborne predators. Speed continuously scales higher as day turns into night.

title: Minefield 95
description: Uncover hidden squares across the minefield using numerical clues to deduce where dangerous explosives lurk.
instructions: Left-click to reveal a cell. Right-click (or hold) to plant a warning flag on suspected mines. Numbers reveal adjacent mine count.

title: Connect Four
description: Drop colored discs into the vertical 7x6 grid. Connect 4 discs vertically, horizontally, or diagonally before your opponent does.
instructions: Take turns dropping discs into any of the 7 columns. Play against a tactical AI bot or challenge a friend in local 2P mode.

title: Pac-Man Arcade
description: Chomp glowing energy dots through the classic maze while outsmarting Blinky, Pinky, Inky, and Clyde. Grab power pellets to hunt the ghosts!
instructions: Navigate the corridors with Arrow keys or WASD. Eat power pellets in the 4 corners to turn ghosts blue and earn bonus points.

title: Asteroids Vector
description: Pilot your vector spacecraft through treacherous asteroid fields. Rotate, thrust with momentum, and blast space rocks into fragments.
instructions: Rotate with Left/Right, fire thrusters with Up or W, and shoot with Space. Clear all asteroid tiers to advance to the next wave.

title: Cyber Highway 85
description: High-octane neon highway traffic runner. Weave between sports cars and heavy trucks, manage nitro boost, and reach blistering speeds.
instructions: Steer between lanes to avoid crashes. Hold Space to engage Nitro Boost when you have fuel. Higher speeds yield higher distance multipliers.

title: Geometry Dash Mini
description: Fast-paced rhythmic obstacle runner. Vault your flipping cube over triangular spikes and launch off yellow booster pads to reach 100%.
instructions: Press Space or Tap to jump. Timing with the audio chimes is essential. Memorize hazard patterns to achieve a complete run.

title: Cyber Reflex Whack
description: Fast reflex arcade testing your reaction speed. Smash glowing cyber target moles across a 3x3 conduit grid in 30 intense seconds.
instructions: Click on moles as soon as they emerge, or use number keys 1 to 9. Golden moles award triple bonus points!

title: Arcade Memory Cards
description: Flip and match 8 pairs of legendary retro arcade relics (Swords, Shields, Potions, Gems, Stars, Coins, Skulls, and Crowns) with minimum moves.
instructions: Click any card to flip it over, then select another card to find its matching twin. Match all 8 pairs to win!
